name: GPT-5.5 Instant

sources.locator: August 6, 2026: Updates to GPT-5.6 in ChatGPT

lifecycle.note: Never offered under its own API id: it was served through the moving alias chat-latest, which is not deprecated. On 2026-08-06 OpenAI said GPT-5.6 Luna would become the default for Free and Go users that week and that GPT-5.6 Sol now powers Instant responses for Plus and Pro users; no source states whether GPT-5.5 Instant is still selectable or retired.

relations.note: Replaced GPT-5.3 Instant as the ChatGPT default; the system card notes there is no GPT-5.4 Instant, so GPT-5.3 Instant is the baseline.

summary.text: GPT-5.5 Instant is the Instant model of OpenAI's GPT-5.5 generation, released on 5 May 2026 as the default ChatGPT model for all users and offered in the API through the chat-latest alias. OpenAI says it gives more factually reliable and more concise answers than GPT-5.3 Instant and makes better use of past chats, files and Gmail to personalise answers.

changes.text: OpenAI reports fewer hallucinated and inaccurate claims than GPT-5.3 Instant in its internal evaluations.
OpenAI describes shorter, more direct answers with fewer follow-up questions, less formatting and fewer emojis.
Makes better use of context from past chats, files and a connected Gmail account to personalise answers, first for Plus and Pro users on the web.
First Instant model that OpenAI treats as High capability in cybersecurity and in biological and chemical risk, deployed with matching safeguards.

inputModalities.note: OpenAI describes improved analysis of photo and image uploads.

access.note: In the API only through the chat-latest alias.

notes: Instant model of the GPT-5.5 generation; GPT-5.5 Thinking is the GPT-5.5 record. Updated in ChatGPT and the API on 2026-05-28 and in ChatGPT on 2026-06-24 (release notes); the chat-latest alias was refreshed on 2026-05-28 (changelog). Context window not stated for the model itself: the chat-latest docs page describes whatever model the alias currently points to, so it is left out. GPT-5.5 Instant Mini (a ChatGPT rate-limit fallback, 2026-07-06) is out of scope.
